messages:
maria: quick pass on the playground streaming controls — attached tiny mocks. main frictions: stop vs pause meaning, token counter prominence, and prompt library peek hiding live output. figma: https://figma.com/file/playground-flow
sam: short list — which two do we ship for beta?
maria: 1) make Stop / Pause behavior explicit + clear copy + undo. 2) reduce token-counter visual weight by default.
alex: dev note: Stop is destructive today, Pause is resumable. i can split actions; prefer an undo toast instead of modal for mobile: 'Generation stopped — Undo' (5s). will debounce token updates to 1s to avoid jank.
aria: accessibility: streaming container needs aria-live="polite". token counter must not be a separate live region. undo toast should receive focus when announced and include an accessible Undo button. Stop needs an accessible name like 'Stop generation (discard partial)'.
maria: copy idea: keep buttons short — 'Stop' (tooltip: 'Stops and discards current output') and 'Pause' (tooltip: 'Pause output; resume later'). tooltips carry extra detail for discoverability.
sam: agree on short labels + tooltips. default token counter inline low-density under prompt; settings toggle to enable a floating pill for power users. track toggle metric.
alex: i’ll implement toggle + debounce + undo toast; responsive behavior for prompt library: split pane on wide screens, overlay on narrow.
deploy-bot: branch 'playground/flow-controls-experiment' created. CI green.
maria: i'll update figma with toast states and copy variants and add an a11y checklist. assigning: @alex implement; @aria own a11y test plan; @sam wire metrics.
sam: will add analytics events and dashboard slices. ETA next Wed.
aria: will run axe + NVDA once branch is staged.
maria: small scope. big clarity. :sparkles:
